title: C-FF/IDFF Managed Multi-Query Scalability Supplement

authorityBoundary.reason: The user authorized the independent C-FF/IDFF MQ study to advance, but has not yet explicitly authorized the MQ-specific estimands, MIPE, multiplicity, power, B-selection, or stopping rules in this proposal. Formal ST rules are not inherited by default.

recommendedScientificQuestion: For each of C-FF and IDFF, does the frozen managed fixed-worker-pool implementation provide statistically supported and practically important reductions in matched batch wall time as physical-core worker count increases within one CCD and from balanced dual-CCD W8 to W16, while preserving all correctness and oracle hard gates?

permitted: descriptive engineering resource and latency distributions
prohibited: causal attribution of CCD differences to cache frequency or any one hardware mechanism

recommendedDesign.stDirectRole: secondary implementation-overhead sentinel and descriptive reference; excluded from the six-test confirmatory scaling family

recommendedPrimaryFamily.singleCcdBlockEstimand: equal-weight OLS slope of log(batchWallSeconds) over log2(workerCount) at W1 W2 W4 W8, computed within each matched block; population estimand is the mean block slope and exp(slope) is the geometric wall-time ratio per worker doubling
recommendedPrimaryFamily.dualCcdBlockEstimand: within-block log(batchWallSeconds_W16 / batchWallSeconds_W8); population estimand is the mean paired log ratio and exp(contrast) is the geometric wall-time ratio

recommendedMipe.interpretation: at least 10 percent lower batch wall time per worker doubling or for W16 versus W8
recommendedMipe.role: prospective planning alternative and practical-importance threshold; it does not move the superiority null

recommendedPrimaryFamily.claimRulePerHypothesis: A confirmatory scaling claim requires Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05, a simultaneous confidence interval entirely below the no-improvement boundary 0 (ratio 1), and a point estimate at or beyond the 10 percent MIPE. Statistical superiority without reaching MIPE is reported as statistically supported but not practically important.
recommendedPrimaryFamily.studyLevelRule: No aggregate winner or majority score. Each of P1 through P6 is reported separately, including estimate, interval, raw and Holm-adjusted p value, direction, MIPE flag, eligibility, and missingness.

recommendedPowerAndSampleSize.planningAlternative: all six primary estimands at the 10 percent MIPE
recommendedPowerAndSampleSize.selectionRule: Before any formal input draw or formal observation, choose the smallest candidate B whose worst of the six opaque-primary Monte Carlo power estimates has a Wilson 95 percent lower bound at least 0.90 after applying the frozen Holm procedure.

allowed: missingness and technical-failure rates without algorithm or condition labels

recommendedPowerAndSampleSize.ifNoCandidatePasses: Do not top up beyond B=144. Stop the design freeze and submit a revised MQ design for explicit user authorization.

recommendedAnalysis.primaryEstimator: mean of matched-block slope or paired log-ratio estimands with block-level robust standard error
distributionalSensitivity: studentized matched-block bootstrap confidence interval with a frozen deterministic seed
secondaryDescriptiveEndpoints: outer lane wall P50 P95 P99 max
explicit workload wall P50 P95 P99 max
query repair and initialization latency distributions
recommendedAnalysis.crossAlgorithmInteractions: exploratory only with estimates and intervals; no winner ranking and no substitution for P1 through P6

recommendedCorrectnessAndStopping.correctnessAndOracleHardGates: all retained and never combined with performance into a weighted score
recommendedCorrectnessAndStopping.technicalFailurePolicy: Fail closed, preserve the complete failed attempt, and require a fresh readiness authorization and entirely new formal execution measured and delivery roots. No observations from a failed attempt may enter a later successful attempt.

runtimeGate.interpretation: Engineering planning only; these values are not formal effects and do not authorize collection.

singleDecisionBundle: six primary estimands P1 through P6
candidate B set 36 72 108 144 and smallest-passing selection rule
power target at least 0.90 using the worst opaque-primary Wilson lower bound
no adaptive reestimation no optional stopping no retry replacement or top-up
all correctness and oracle hard gates retained
secondary endpoints and cross-algorithm analyses remain descriptive or exploratory
authorizationNeeded.recommendedUserAuthorizationText: 我授权 Gate14Re-MQ-CFF-IDFF 独立 MQ 正式设计按 formal-mq-design-recommendation.v1 执行：六项主检验、MQ 专属 10% MIPE、单侧 Holm FWER 0.05、仅使用 identity-blind nuisance inputs 做功效，在 B=36/72/108/144 中选择最小满足最差主检验 Wilson 95% 功效下界不低于 0.90 的 B；保留全部 correctness/oracle 硬门，不允许正式启动后的重估、获益或无效停止、retry、replacement、top-up 或跨 attempt 合并。授权完成只读功效、正式设计/实现/日程冻结与 prelaunch readiness；正式 collection 在 readiness PASS 后仍须单独报告并等待我明确启动授权。
